assertions.predicate: After merge and deployment, run node scripts/prove-asset-manifest-publication.mjs --origin https://app.doctorcre.com --commit DEPLOYED_MERGE_COMMIT --timeout-ms 30000, substituting the exact deployed merge commit. The CLI performs four credential-free GETs with no redirects or retries under one total deadline. Require /app-release service doctorcre-app and environment production; require /artifact-manifest.json schema doctorcre-static-artifact.v1, repository DoctorCRE/doctorcre-app or its historical alias jbookout/doctorcre-app, application/json and Cache-Control no-store. Both source_commit fields must equal that commit. Validate manifest rows and select the first two paths in lexicographic order matching js/*.js from the built manifest, without a hand-maintained bundle list. Fetch those same-origin paths and require their byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes to match their manifest rows. Any conflict or missing evidence fails.
assertions.expected_result: All four production GETs return 200. CLI exits zero and emits status passed, full release identity, manifest_sha256 and two assets with path, bytes and sha256. Selected assets come from the deployed manifest and survive bundle renames. Any missing evidence or conflict exits nonzero.
assertions.input_class: read-only public build identity, manifest and two deployed JavaScript assets
